email.subject: Quick note on Mane Street Pros' site
email.body:
Hi Omar,

I took a look at Mane Street Pros' website. Two things are likely costing you bookings: the site isn't mobile-friendly, and most people search for salons on their phone first, so they're probably bouncing before they see your services. There's also no reviews section, which matters a lot for hair studios since people usually check reviews before booking.

I fix both of these for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what I'd do? No obligation either way.

Best,
Alex
